# Move seed corpus and dictionary.
mv $SRC/{*.zip,*.dict} $OUT

mkdir build && cd build
cmake ../ -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF
make
$CC $CFLAGS -c ../test/fuzzers/fuzz-mdhtml.c -I../src
$CXX $CXXFLAGS $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE fuzz-mdhtml.o -o $OUT/fuzz-mdhtml \
    ./src/libmd4c-html.a ./src/libmd4c.a

if [ -d "$SRC/test/fuzzers/seed-corpus" ]; then
    zip -j $OUT/fuzz-mdhtml_seed_corpus.zip $SRC/test/fuzzers/seed-corpus/*
fi
project_yaml:
homepage: "https://github.com/mity/md4c"
main_repo: "https://github.com/mity/md4c"
primary_contact: "mity.ossfuzz@gmail.com"
base_os_version: ubuntu-24-04
language: c
file_github_issue: true
auto_ccs:
  - "david@adalogics.com"

FROM gcr.io/oss-fuzz-base/base-builder:ubuntu-24-04
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y make cmake
RUN git clone https://github.com/mity/md4c

# Dictionaries:
RUN git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/google/fuzzing && \
    mv fuzzing/dictionaries/markdown.dict $SRC/fuzz-mdhtml.dict && \
    rm -rf fuzzing

# Seed corpus:
RUN zip -j $SRC/fuzz-mdhtml_seed_corpus.zip $SRC/md4c/test/fuzzers/seed-corpus/*

WORKDIR $SRC/md4c
COPY run_tests.sh build.sh $SRC/
